decision.observation: Card choice: Combust (1: at end of turn lose 1 HP, deal 5 to ALL enemies), Sword Boomerang (1: deal 3 damage to a random enemy 3 times), Thunderclap (1: deal 4 damage and apply 1 Vulnerable to ALL enemies).
decision.hypothesis: Thunderclap gains 8 damage/enemy with +4 Strength and applies Vulnerable to all, amplifying follow-up attacks; Combust costs HP that's already scarce at 42/80.
decision.memory: +4 Strength from two Inflames; AOE+Vulnerable cards have high synergy.
